Martin Buber on relation

Martin Buber (1878–1965) approaches relation within dialogical philosophy. I–Thou relation addresses another as a presence rather than an object; dialogue grounds ethical and religious life. Systematically, the teaching links dialogue, relation, religion into a practical and theoretical whole. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets relation most directly—useful for searches such as “martin buber quotes on relation.”

How to use this page

Start with the shortest passage, then compare tone across sources. Return to the Martin Buber thinker page for biography and to the relation theme for other voices on the same question.
